status: native Isaac charging prototype; full scripted and Dream validation in progress
engine_required_by_user: Isaac on 5090; do not use MuJoCo

iphone17.attachment_requirement: Align rear magnetic charging region, then support released phone through finite magnetic forces and physical contacts; no pose snapping

airpods_pro.charging_feedback: physical case status light; not a permanent LED
airpods_pro.attachment_requirement: Case supported by bottom pad; no strong magnetic retention

apple_watch.band: flexible and contact-bearing; may obstruct charger
apple_watch.attachment_requirement: Magnetic attachment and back contact; flexible band must not obstruct charging surface

charger.reference: Belkin WIZ023-inspired; user-requested wider head spacing and physical shallow recess; internal dimensions approximate

airpods_recess.native_concave_collision: 96 convex rim sectors above a solid lower floor

initial_layout: random non-overlapping tabletop positions and yaw; seed saved

robot.charging_verification: Observe on-device phone/watch charging cues and AirPods case status light through original cameras

success_requested: all three devices charging correctly; stand remains near its original pose
partial_credit_proposal: Each device earns up to one third after charging with no gripper contact (including watch band), visible RGB feedback and five seconds of released stability. Stand stability required.
validation_boundary: Finite paired magnetic forces and contact/coil alignment gate a reduced charging proxy. Green phone/watch startup animation and amber case LED are simulated feedback, not independent proof of electromagnetic power transfer. Forces, strap stiffness and charger internal geometry require hardware calibration.
